title: Real machine admission fixture
summary: The setup operation fixture.machine-admission-prepare runs the installed candidate's own machine_qa_admission_host on the test machine with the current CLI release's interpreter (the yoke launcher runs on uv's base Python, which cannot import the release), so the exact candidate serves admission journeys; a failed step records its named reason in the case evidence. Modes self-hosted and self-hosted-company-sign-in boot the unchanged self-host server entrypoint on loopback (ports 19121 and 19122) with YOKE_SERVER_MODE=self-host as the bundle sets it against a disposable embedded Postgres; the real first boot creates the Fixture Owner and saves the owner's token owner-only with an approver config the run's admission gates use through YOKE_MACHINE_HOME. Company sign-in adds a disposable stub provider whose only identity is the teammate, after the owner runs yoke invite EMAIL --role operator (an email invite without a role grants none). Mode local runs the real yoke init --local in a fixture-only machine home. The fixture never approves, invites a machine or redeems anything; the journey's gates do. The post-state assertion fixture.machine-admission-state-assert compares people, machines, active credentials, linked identities and consumed teammate invites (exactly one, consumed by the new machine, on self-hosted) and the teammate's org role with the baseline recorded at start (owner-admitted, teammate-admitted or nothing-admitted) and fails as machine_admission_state_mismatch with the changed rows and new_issued_invites (0 means the owner's invite never reached this universe); the case keeps the journey's own evidence, and a journey that failed reports its own error first. Start and cleanup refusals keep their named reason in the operation row; crashes retain a bounded stderr tail including exception type and message. Cleanup is registered before start and retries when it fails; its final attempt determines cleanup success after the fixture root is verified removed, and evidence retains every attempt. A recovered cleanup leaves the case verdict to its journey and assertions.
